title: Road arrival on 0.4.7, one synthetic route
route_fixture: Map-selected synthetic Berlin points; live Valhalla route, 1319.29 m
limitations: One physical phone, one route, one speed, one run. Fixes are sampled at about 1 s, so the arrival moment is known to about one tick. App status was sampled every 1 to 2 s. Delivery to other apps not measured.
deviations: The start pin was placed by a map tap, and the destination pin by dragging, because taps near a pin do not reach the map. The route was saved temporarily to read its geometry, then deleted. The commit is the protocol revision; the app source matches 0.4.7.
